stemMarkdown: In a race of 1000 m, the ratio of speeds of A and B is 7:3. If they start together, by what distance (in m) does A win when A finishes the race? (2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 1000 m, B covers $\dfrac{3}{7} \times 1000 = 428.57$ m (same time, speeds proportional to distance covered). A wins by $= 1000 - 428.57 = 571.43$ m.
